dataset.case_hash_encoding: SHA256 over ordered ASCII prompt + TAB + answer + LF
dataset.grammar: two xyz prefix chars + one payload bit + 16 xyz distractors + '?'
dataset.source: existing Rust memory diagnostic delay-16 stage, unchanged
dataset.vocabulary_fitted_on: union of all curriculum training-stage prompts only, to preserve the same 7-token vocabulary; no held-out prompts consulted

device_identity: Some(DeviceIdentity { name: "AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT", fingerprint: "spirv_4098_30096", physical: Some(PhysicalDevice { pci_address: None, luid: None, registry_entry_id: None, vendor: Some(Amd) }) })

protocol.criterion: Both mean held-out accuracy >= best other retrained mode +0.05; positive paired accuracy difference for at least 2 of 3 default seeds; lower paired mean held-out NLL
protocol.initialization: identical initial parameters per seed across all modes; fresh Adam for every condition
protocol.loss: full-vocabulary mean cross entropy only at final '?' position; all earlier masks zero
protocol.state: zero all states independently for every prompt/update
protocol.updates: exactly the configured count for every condition, with no early stopping or validation-based selection

schedule.index_encoding: little-endian u64 indices, once; repeat identical batch each update
schedule.kind: full batch of the same 16 delay-16 training cases, in the recorded order, every update for every condition/seed

scope: Matched feedback comparison on one-bit long-delay recall; independent cold starts, no curriculum or transferred weights; not emotional reasoning or language generation validation
